summary: Iteration 6 (image_style picker + credit banner) validated end-to-end. Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_reels_sixth_batch.py — 9/9 pytest cases pass in ~20s against the public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. GET /api/config now returns image_styles containing all four expected ids [cinematic, photoreal, anime, painterly] with name+suffix payload. POST /api/reels {input_mode:'script', script:'A short test line.', visual_mode:'ai', image_style:'anime', voice_id:'onyx'} returns 200, echoes visual_mode='ai', image_style='anime', status='queued'. POST /api/reels with image_style omitted defaults to 'cinematic' as expected. Unknown image_style (e.g. 'totally-fake-style') is clamped server-side to 'cinematic' (server.py:152). No 500s on /api/config or /api/reels. ROOT-CAUSE reconfirmed: backend.err.log still shows `litellm.BadRequestError: OpenAIException - Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 1.4571832500338555, Max budget: 1.4` — env/credits issue, not a code bug. Frontend (Expo web @ 390x844): Create screen renders the amber dismissible credit-banner at the top (copy: 'Your AI credits ran out — top up your Universal Key to generate. Tap to dismiss.') because a recent reel failed with a budget error. Tapping VISUAL STYLE → AI IMAGES (data-testid segment-ai — Segmented component scopes children as `segment-{id}` not `visual-mode-segment-ai`) reveals the new IMAGE STYLE chip row. All four chip testIDs render and are tappable: image-style-cinematic (default active), image-style-photoreal, image-style-anime, image-style-painterly. Toggling between chips updates the active outline. Switching back to GRADIENT hides the entire chip row. Tapping the credit-banner dismisses it (element removed from tree). No red screen errors; only pre-existing React 19 `props.pointerEvents is deprecated` warning from prior iterations.
